description: This file contains unit tests for the ExecHostRequestEvaluator component within the OpenClaw project. The tests validate request handling, decision logic for approval or denial, and context creation related to command execution authorization.

classes.name: ExecHostRequestEvaluatorTests
classes.description: A struct encapsulating multiple test cases for the ExecHostRequestEvaluator component.

methods.name: validate request rejects empty command
methods.description: Tests that an empty command in the request leads to an invalid request error.

methods.name: evaluate requires prompt on allowlist miss without decision
methods.description: Tests that a request on an allowlist with no prior decisions requires a prompt.

methods.name: evaluate allows allow once decision on allowlist miss
methods.description: Validates that an allowOnce decision permits command execution when not on the allowlist.

methods.name: evaluate denies on explicit deny decision
methods.description: Ensures that a user-denied decision is properly handled and results in denial.

methods.name: makeContext
methods.description: Creates a mock evaluation context for testing decision logic based on security settings and allowlist status.
